headline: Windows long-path + SIGHUP config reload + beta auto-update channel

items.title: Windows long-path (`\\?\`) support across the sync path
items.body: Every filesystem-touching call in `lib/watcher.js`, `lib/sync-engine.js`, and `lib/checksum.js` now opts into the Windows long-path API so paths beyond the legacy MAX_PATH (260 chars) no longer truncate or fail with `ENOENT`. Behavior on Linux / macOS is unchanged.

items.title: `SIGHUP` reloads `config.json` in-place
items.body: The daemon's `SIGHUP` handler now re-reads `config.json` and applies non-structural changes (sync paths, ignore patterns, bandwidth caps, log level) without a restart. Structural changes that require a re-handshake (server URL, mTLS cert/key) still need a full restart; the handler logs which keys were re-applied vs ignored.

items.title: Opt-in `beta` auto-update channel
items.body: `autoUpdateChannel: 'beta'` in `config.json` (or `--channel=beta` on the CLI) makes the updater include pre-release tags when polling for the next version. Default channel remains `stable` (release-tag-only).
